task: round 38 skeptic (value + feasibility) of R38T-H2: exp89t S1 re-saves until 19:50Z
reason: Refuted as proposed. (1) VALUE on private is about 0. The rule only matters when exp89t reads 0.959, the same display as the champion exp87a. The two files differ only by DIS 2.25, whose indirect LB estimate is 0.000 +-0.002 (09:19Z read of exp89r). A sub-rounding public UP on one embryo (about 29% of test) says almost nothing about the 71% private split, and exp89t adds a 4th, untested lever. Resolving a BLIND case therefore swaps two files with the same expected private score. (2) The probability is overstated. Across about 11 logged S1 downloads (27-29 Sep: CONTEXT l.2791, 2873, 3197, 3308, 3617, 3641, 3858, 4155, and post_exp75), none lagged and none failed outside the 05:30-05:57Z trip outage. With the existing R35-A1 lag re-save, P(still unresolved) is about 1-3%, not 5-10%. The expected number of V_pub decisions resolved is about 0.2-0.5%, not 1-3%. (3) The claim 'a later S1 can only lower k, never create a false pass' has a hole. If slot 2 is used (exp89s, non-CI, sent at about 12:00Z, reads at about 19:05-19:15Z), a lagging LB that shows count 57 after both files completed may reflect exp89s rather than exp89t. The UP would then be credited to the wrong file. A re-save window stretched to 19:50Z overlaps exactly that completion window. (4) The 19:50Z end conflicts with the logged 10.75 h admit edge and the card's 'до 22:45 МСК' swap promise (19:45:17Z). It would leave the user under 10 min before the 20:00Z tick. (5) R19-A1 (27 Sep) already allowed 3 re-downloads, and R35-A1 deliberately narrowed that to one, so this is a re-widening, not a new finding. Cost is small (at most 3 read-only downloads) and nothing touches a kernel (byte identity is not an issue), but a near-zero gain does not justify a rule change on the last day.
fix: If logged at all, log only this narrow fail-soft variant before exp89t's read. 'exp89t S1: if the post_exp89t download FAILS (error or timeout 180 s), retry at most 2 times about 5 min apart; the existing R35-A1 single lag re-save stays as is. The last attempt starts by 19:40Z, so that any swap message goes out by 19:45Z (22:45 MSK) as the card promises. S1 is valid only if our count is exactly S0 + 1 = 57 AND no other of our refs (slot 2) turned terminal between S0 and S1; otherwise MASKED. No valid S1 -> BLIND, and exp87a stays.' Run every save as 'timeout 180 python tools/uptest.py save post_exp89t[_b|_c]'. No other change.
realistic_gain: About 0 on private. It resolves about 0.2-0.5% of V_pub decisions, and those are between two 0.959 files that differ by DIS (LB estimate 0.000 +-0.002). Expected private delta is well under 0.0001. Its only real benefit is procedural: it keeps a network blip from turning into BLIND.
